extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the stores.

extDescription.message: Plays every web video at 2× by default. Change the speed per video, or turn it off per site.

speedValue.description: A playback speed, such as 2× or 1.75×.

commandSpeedUp.message: Speed up the videos in this tab
commandSpeedUp.description: Shown next to the Alt+. shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

commandSlowDown.message: Slow down the videos in this tab
commandSlowDown.description: Shown next to the Alt+, shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

commandToggleSpeed.message: Switch between 1× and your default speed
commandToggleSpeed.description: Shown next to the Alt+R shortcut in the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

popupSiteSwitch.description: Accessible name of the popup's on/off switch for the site in the address bar.

popupSiteSwitchUnavailable.message: Speed up videos on this page
popupSiteSwitchUnavailable.description: Accessible name of the popup's on/off switch on a page the extension can't run on, where the switch is disabled.

popupSiteOn.message: Videos play at your default speed.
popupSiteOn.description: Under the site name when the extension is on for the site.

popupSiteOff.message: Off. The site sets the speed.
popupSiteOff.description: Under the site name when the user has turned the extension off for the site.

popupSiteLocked.message: Off for all of $PATTERN$ by a rule in your site list.
popupSiteLocked.description: Under the site name when a rule covering the site and its subdomains turns it off, so the switch can't turn it on.

popupNoAccess.message: Doublespeed doesn't have access to this page. Allowing it reloads the page.
popupNoAccess.description: Shown instead of the site switch when the browser withholds site access (Chrome's "on click" or specific sites, Firefox's add-on settings). A hidden page address can also mean a browser page; once access is allowed, the popup says so instead.

popupGrantAccess.description: Button under popupNoAccess. Asks the browser for access to every site; the page reloads once it's allowed.

popupPageBrowser.message: Browsers don't let extensions run on their own pages.
popupPageBrowser.description: Shown instead of the site switch on browser pages: settings, the new tab page, about: pages, extension pages.

popupPageBrowserOrFile.message: Browsers don't let extensions run on their own pages. If this is a file on your computer, Doublespeed needs access to file URLs.
popupPageBrowserOrFile.description: Chrome only. Shown instead of the site switch when the page's address is hidden and file access is off, so it's either a browser page or a local file; the extension can't tell which.

popupFileAccess.description: Link under popupPageBrowserOrFile. Opens the extension's details page in Chrome, where the switch has this same name.

popupPageStore.message: Browsers don't let extensions run on extension stores.
popupPageStore.description: Shown instead of the site switch on the Chrome Web Store and addons.mozilla.org.

popupPageNoSite.message: This page isn't on a website, so there's no site to turn off.
popupPageNoSite.description: Shown instead of the site switch on local files, which have no site name.

popupTabSpeed.description: Label of the popup's control for the speed of the videos in the current tab.

popupTabNoVideo.description: In place of this tab's speed in the popup, when the tab has no video.

popupTabOff.description: In place of this tab's speed in the popup, when the site is turned off.

badgeOff.description: Toolbar badge on a site the user turned off. Keep it to 3 or 4 characters.

popupDefaultSpeed.description: Label of the popup's control for the speed every video starts at.

popupDefaultSlower.description: Accessible name of the − button next to the default speed.

popupDefaultFaster.description: Accessible name of the + button next to the default speed.

popupHintTitle.message: Change the speed from the keyboard
popupHintTitle.description: Heading of the popup's one-time hint listing the extension's keyboard shortcuts.

popupHintSpeedUp.description: In the shortcut hint, next to the speed-up shortcut (Alt+.).

popupHintSlowDown.description: In the shortcut hint, next to the slow-down shortcut (Alt+,).

popupHintToggle.description: In the shortcut hint, next to the shortcut that switches between 1× and the default speed (Alt+R).

popupHintDismiss.description: Button that hides the shortcut hint for good.

popupSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
popupSaveFailed.description: Shown in the popup when the browser refuses to save a setting.

popupSiteList.description: Link at the bottom of the popup that opens the options page with the list of sites the extension is off on.

optionsTitle.description: Browser tab title of the options page.

optionsSitesTitle.description: Heading of the options page's list of disabled sites.

optionsSitesIntro.message: Videos on these sites play at whatever speed the site chooses.
optionsSitesIntro.description: Under the heading of the list of disabled sites.

optionsAddLabel.description: Label of the field where the user types or pastes a site to turn off.

optionsAddPlaceholder.message: A link, or a site such as youtube.com
optionsAddPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the Add site field.

optionsAddButton.description: Button that adds the site in the Add site field to the list.

optionsIncludeSubdomains.description: Checkbox under the Add site field. Ticked, the rule also covers every subdomain of the site (music.youtube.com for youtube.com).

optionsPreviewExact.description: Under the Add site field: what adding it will turn off.

optionsPreviewWildcard.message: Turns off $HOST$ and all its subdomains.
optionsPreviewWildcard.description: Under the Add site field, with Include subdomains ticked: what adding it will turn off.

optionsInvalid.description: Under the Add site field when what was typed isn't a site or a web link.

optionsNoSubdomains.message: $HOST$ is an IP address, so it has no subdomains.
optionsNoSubdomains.description: Under the Add site field when Include subdomains is ticked for an IP address.

optionsDuplicate.description: Under the Add site field when the site is already on the list.

optionsCovered.description: Under the Add site field when a rule for a site and all its subdomains already turns the site off.

optionsListFull.message: The list is full. Remove a site to add another.
optionsListFull.description: Shown when the browser's sync storage has no room for another site (about 500).

optionsSaveFailed.message: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
optionsSaveFailed.description: Shown on the options page when the browser refuses to save a change.

optionsSubdomains.description: Next to a site in the list whose rule also covers its subdomains.

optionsRemove.description: Button next to each site in the list.

optionsRemoveSite.description: Accessible name of the Remove button next to a site.

optionsEmpty.message: No sites yet. Videos play at your default speed everywhere.
optionsEmpty.description: In place of the list when no site is turned off.

optionsShortcutsTitle.description: Heading of the options page's list of shortcuts.

optionsShortcutUnset.description: In place of a shortcut's keys when it has none (another extension took them, or the user removed them).

optionsShortcutsChange.description: Link that opens the browser's keyboard shortcut settings.

optionsShortcutsSteps.message: To change them, open about:addons, click the gear button, and choose Manage Extension Shortcuts.
optionsShortcutsSteps.description: On Firefox versions that can't open their shortcut settings for an extension: how to get there by hand. Use Firefox's own names for the menu items.
